Accessories & Safety

Whip Check Safety Cable

Retention cable that prevents hose whip on disconnection.

Whip check safety cable in stainless steel that links two hoses or a hose to a tool, preventing dangerous whipping if the connection fails under pressure. An essential safety element on air and water lines.

Ask about this product +507 308-8843

Price available upon request. Specifications subject to availability.

Material

  • Pressurized water hoses
  • Mining
